learnings: The audit tool should gracefully handle API or parse errors on non-executable files (like .SRCINFO, README.md, or config templates) and still issue a final verdict based on the successfully audited critical files (PKGBUILD, install hooks, wrapper scripts).

File selection logic should filter out or deprioritize static upstream HTML assets (eula.html, privacy.html, terms.html) as they are never executed during makepkg and only consume tokens while risking model confusion over third-party analytics scripts.
